ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: Two factors drove it. First, the underlying task is a quantitative physics question (ultrasound resolution vs. theory), and Plover holds a clear edge on the relevant knowledge benchmarks — GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs. 55.6 and MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs. 75.4 — gaps well outside variance. Second, the user's tone is curt and dismissive ("Don't waste my time"). Willet's documentation reports a self-reported preference decline on hostile or low-warmth requests, whereas Plover's preferences are flat across tone. Since preference effects don't impact output quality per the docs, this is secondary, but it still made Plover the cleaner pick on both axes.
